import copy,fcntl,json,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.decision_evidence_transfer import RankedOnline,EDIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD,evidence_proposals,procedure_payload
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import ROOT,read,sha,now,points
from legal_skill_guard.learning.catalog import encode_teacher_body
from legal_skill_guard.learning.packing import expand
from legal_skill_guard.learning.publication import differential_schema,apply_differential_publication,publication_statistics
from legal_skill_guard.learning.member_learning import paired_effect
from legal_skill_guard.learning.evidence_actions import COMPILER_SYSTEM,GROUP_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA,validate_group_library,execute_evidence_groups,evidence_action_payload,action_metric_view
from legal_skill_guard.learning.executable_features import BUILTINS,ATTRIBUTES
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha

class EvidenceActionProbe(RankedOnline):
    def execute(self):
        assert self.cfg["method"]==EDIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD and len(self.documents)==8
        assert [r["id"] for r in self.documents]==[232,349,607,156,303,161,602,143]
        terminal=read(ROOT/self.cfg["reference_terminal_preservation"])
        assert terminal["state"]=="terminal_results_preserved" and terminal["all_members_verified"]
        assert sha(terminal["archive"])==sha(terminal["rootdisk_copy"])==terminal["archive_sha256"]
        reference=read(ROOT/self.cfg["prose_candidate_reference"])
        assert self.bank==reference["reference_bank"] and len(self.prefix_ids)==234
        self.validate_runtime_bank();self.current_batch=5
        fit=read(ROOT/self.cfg["ordinary_manifest"]);self.fit_records=[fit]
        self.record("declaration.json",{"at":now(),"config":self.cfg,"frozen_bindings":self.bindings.copy(),
            "fixed_prose_control_is_sole_unpublished_candidate_not_original_run_publication":True,
            "original_run_remains_failed80_native4_teacher3_fit":True,
            "all4_arms_all8_forward_sources_before_any_forward_Gold_grading":True,
            "source_only_compiler_arguments_no_current_Gold_ID_or_model":True,
            "singleton_actions_preserve_every_original_evidence_set":True,
            "planned_native_teacher_CPUfits":[32,1,1],
            "one_CPU_fit_already_executed_before_launch_included_not_hidden":fit,
            "not_formal128_independent_repeat_or_official_TEST":True})
        body=read(ROOT/self.cfg["compiler_body"])
        sources=expand(body["complete_new_and_previous_batch_original_sources_and_Gold"])
        allowed=[r["id"] for r in sources]
        assert len(allowed)==16 and not set(allowed)&{r["id"] for r in self.documents}
        body["documented_pure_builtins"]=list(BUILTINS);body["documented_pure_attributes"]=sorted(ATTRIBUTES)
        body["compiler_API"]["re_is_preprovided_do_not_import"]=True
        body["library_budget"]={"current_target8B_tokens":0,"target_tokens":3200,"hard_tokens":4096}
        schema=differential_schema(self.labels,[],allowed,guidance_schema=GROUP_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA)
        self.record("learning_inputs/initial_compiler.json",body)
        delta=self.teacher_call("initial_evidence_action_compilation",COMPILER_SYSTEM,encode_teacher_body(body),schema)
        programs=apply_differential_publication([],delta,self.labels,allowed,guidance_schema=GROUP_GUIDANCE_SCHEMA)
        validate_group_library(programs,self.labels)
        tokens=self.meter.token_count(text=json.dumps(programs,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":")))
        assert tokens<=4096,"No program truncation, repair, scored selection or retry"
        self.record("publications/compiled_actions.json",{"at":now(),"parent":[],"delta":delta,
            "program_library":programs,"statistics":publication_statistics([],delta,programs,tokens),
            "all_structurally_valid_programs_used_without_efficacy_gate":True,
            "not_a_legal_verdict_or_mandatory_citation_generator":True})
        phases=["native_empty","native_prose","bundle_context_prose","atomic_actions_prose"]
        execution_count=0;execution_seconds=0
        for index,row in enumerate(self.documents):
            leads=evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels)
            menus,receipts=execute_evidence_groups(programs,row,self.labels,leads)
            execution_count+=len(receipts);execution_seconds+=sum(x["CPU_seconds"] for x in receipts)
            self.record(f"source_actions/{row['id']}.json",{"at":now(),"menus":menus,"receipts":receipts,
                "program_bank_sha256":csha(programs),"same_proposals_all4_arms":leads,
                "no_current_Gold_or_final_answers_in_source_execution":True})
            order=phases[index%4:]+phases[:index%4]
            for variant in order:
                self.phase="forward8_"+variant
                role="joint_empty" if variant=="native_empty" else "skills"
                if variant in ("native_empty","native_prose"):
                    messages,answer_schema=procedure_payload(row,self.labels,leads,self.cfg["bundled_solver_system"],
                        [] if variant=="native_empty" else self.bank,public_reason_words=64)
                else:
                    messages,answer_schema=evidence_action_payload(row,self.labels,leads,self.cfg["bundled_solver_system"],
                        self.bank,menus,atomic=variant=="atomic_actions_prose")
                native=self.generate(row,role,messages,answer_schema)
                response=action_metric_view(native,self.labels,answer_schema) if variant=="atomic_actions_prose" else native
                self.logical(row,role,response)
                if variant=="atomic_actions_prose":
                    value=response["actual_native_action_value"];used=[]
                    if not response["action_projection_errors"]:
                        for h in self.labels:
                            for action in value[h]["actions"]:
                                if action["action_id"].startswith("B"):
                                    used.append({"hypothesis_id":h,**action})
                    self.record(f"actual_macro_selections/{row['id']}.json",{"at":now(),
                        "actual_native_raw_id":native["raw_id"],"native_compound_action_selections":used,
                        "selected_member_indices_explicitly_emitted_not_host_inserted":True,
                        "invalid_response_not_substituted":bool(response["action_projection_errors"])})
        assert len(self.native)==32 and len(self.answers)==32 and len(self.teachers)==1
        units=self.score(self.answers);self.units=units
        groups={a:[u for u in units if u["stage"]=="forward8_"+a] for a in phases}
        assert all(len(v)==8 for v in groups.values())
        metrics={a:points(v) for a,v in groups.items()}
        effects={a:paired_effect(groups["native_empty"],groups[a],seed=2026101950+i,replicates=5000)
                 for i,a in enumerate(phases) if a!="native_empty"}
        mechanism=paired_effect(groups["bundle_context_prose"],groups["atomic_actions_prose"],
            seed=2026101959,replicates=5000)
        result={"at":now(),"run_id":self.run_id,"all8_forward_original_metrics":metrics,
            "same_case_effects_vs_original_empty":effects,"atomic_vs_same_bundle_context_effect":mechanism,
            "actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[32,1,1],
            "prior_failed_runtime_development_family_native_teacher_CPUfits":[113,5,4],
            "total_this_development_family_native_teacher_CPUfits":[145,6,5],
            "actual_pure_program_CPU_invocations":execution_count,"actual_pure_program_CPU_seconds":execution_seconds,
            "compiled_program_library":programs,"fixed_prose_reference":self.bank,"units":units,
            "all_adverse_cases_arms_invalids_and_original_denominators_retained":True,
            "first8_prefix32_scope_fixed_before_any_forward_score":True,
            "not_full128_independent_repeat_or_official_TEST":True}
        self.record("completion.json",result)
        RunStore.atomic_json(self.out/"progress.json",{"at":now(),"state":"completed","run_id":self.run_id,
            "completed_native_calls":32,"completed_teacher_calls":1,"actual_CPUfits":1,"forward_metrics":metrics})
        print(json.dumps({"completed":self.run_id,"forward_metrics":metrics}),flush=True)

with (ROOT/"artifacts/gpu_generation.lock").open("a+") as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    study=EvidenceActionProbe(Path(sys.argv[1]))
    try:study.execute()
    except BaseException as error:
        failure={"at":now(),"state":"failed","error":repr(error),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),
            "actual_new_native_teacher_calls":[len(study.native),len(study.teachers)],
            "one_actual_prior_common_CPUfit_in_definition":True,
            "no_retry_answer_repair_fallback_or_selected_bank":True}
        study.record("failure.json",failure);RunStore.atomic_json(study.out/"progress.json",failure);raise
